meta.title: Marks of excellence
meta.description: The 65, 85, 95 and 100 % thresholds of every tank with history and projection.

hero.title: How much damage <hot>three marks</hot> take
hero.lead: A mark shows the share of players on a tank you beat by average combined damage (damage + the higher of spotting and tracking assist) over roughly your last 100 battles. 65 % earns the first stripe, 85 % the second, 95 % the third. Thresholds move every day: we keep their whole history and show where a mark got easier.

ruler.label: Mark scale: 65, 85 and 95 percent
ruler.caption: Each battle moves the percent by about 2 % of the gap between your damage and the current bar — one bad game barely hurts, a streak of good ones moves it fast.

table.title: Thresholds for every tank
table.description: Average combined damage for 65, 85, 95 and 100 %. A threshold that fell over 30 days means the mark got easier.

research.title: XP and credits to a tank
research.description: Pick a tank — we take its research and purchase cost from the tech tree (or a tier estimate) and count the battles left.
research.footer: Costs come from the nation's tech tree; without data a tier average is used. A premium account adds +50 % XP and credits.
research.pickDescription: We count the XP and credits still missing to research and buy it.
research.premiumTankHint: Premium tanks are bought for gold or in the shop — no XP to grind.
research.days: ≈ {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} at {perDay} battles a day

target.title: Battles to a goal
target.description: How many battles lift your overall win rate, average damage or WN8 to a target, given how you expect to play in each new battle.

footer.winRate: Win rate is a plain average over all battles, so the result is exact.
footer.avgDamage: Average damage is a plain average over all battles, so the result is exact.
footer.wn8: Account WN8 is approximated as a battle-weighted average of per-battle WN8. The real value depends on the tanks you play.

target.doneHint: The current value is at or above the target — raise the bar.
target.impossibleHint: As long as new battles are no better than {target}, the overall value never gets there. Raise the expected result.
target.battlesHint: From {from} to {to} at the expected pace
target.curveAria: How the metric grows with new battles

moe.title: Battles to a mark
moe.description: A short version of the projection: current percent, average combined damage and target. The full chart lives on the marks page.
moe.damageHint: Damage + the higher of spotting and tracking assist
moe.pickDescription: We take the current thresholds and count the battles to the mark.
moe.unreachable: This damage will not get the mark
moe.noDataHint: This tank has no thresholds yet or the damage is empty.

crew.title: Crew experience
crew.description: Battles to the next skill. Each new skill costs twice the previous one, and the last percents are the most expensive.
crew.footer: Formula: XP per percent = 50 · 100^(level/100) · 2^skill number. The first skill is about 220k XP, the second twice that. Bonuses multiply.

economy.title: Battle economy
economy.description: Estimate the income and costs of an average battle — repair, shells and consumables — and what is left with and without premium.
economy.footer: Income is estimated from tier, damage and spotting; shell prices default to the tier and can be edited. Premium adds +50 % income, costs stay the same.
economy.chartAria: Income and costs per battle with and without premium

gold.title: Gold
gold.description: How many credits and how much free XP gold buys — and how much gold a given amount needs.
gold.footer: Rates: 1 gold = {credits} credits, 1 gold = {xp} free XP (converting XP from elite tanks).

pass.title: Battle pass
pass.description: How many battles a day finish the pass before the season ends, and when you finish at your current pace.
pass.footer: Points per battle depend on the result and your place in the team — use your average over the last few days.
